hero.description: ANAEROBIA, S.A. DE C.V. GENERAL PURCHASING CONDITIONS

contenido.content:
ANAEROBIA, S.A. DE C.V. (hereinafter "ANAEROBIA") and the supplier (hereinafter "THE SUPPLIER") expressly agree that the following clauses govern the operation(s) agreed between both parties, and are effective for all operations described and agreed in the PURCHASE ORDER, as well as for the delivery of drawings and technical data necessary for the correct and complete execution of the established scope; these clauses, together with the Supplier Code of Ethics of Anaerobia issued in May 2019, will be valid throughout the development of this PURCHASE ORDER.

CLAUSES

1. PURCHASE ORDER

a) THE SUPPLIER acknowledges and agrees to be bound by the terms and conditions set forth in the PURCHASE ORDER, which, through the negotiation protocol, it has accepted of its own free will, after quoting the scope and with full knowledge of the project.

b) The PURCHASE ORDER delivered, whether physically or electronically, will be legally binding on both parties once it has been accepted, without delay and without changes by the supplier, through the handwritten signature on the PURCHASE ORDER of its legal representative, duly empowered attorney-in-fact, or person authorized by THE SUPPLIER for such purposes. If acceptance of the PURCHASE ORDER is not delivered to ANAEROBIA within a maximum period of 2 (two) business days from the date of the PURCHASE ORDER, ANAEROBIA has the right to cancel or reject the items and/or services the supplier may have produced in relation thereto, without any liability whatsoever for ANAEROBIA.

c) The PURCHASE ORDER creates obligations and rights only between the parties that enter into it; therefore, if THE SUPPLIER does not have prior written authorization from ANAEROBIA, it will not have the authority to assign, in whole or in part, the obligations and rights it acquires under the PURCHASE ORDER, nor to subcontract third parties for its execution.

d) These purchasing terms and conditions will govern the agreements established by both parties. Therefore, no different condition proposed by the supplier will apply unless it has been previously agreed and negotiated with ANAEROBIA.

2. SUPPLIER'S RESPONSIBILITIES

a) THE SUPPLIER states that its activities include the manufacture and/or distribution of the items and/or provision of services that are the subject of the PURCHASE ORDER, and that it carries out this activity for the general public. It acknowledges that it is an expert in the manufacture and/or distribution and/or provision of the goods and/or services covered by the PURCHASE ORDER and that it therefore has knowledge of the legal provisions related to these activities, which must be carried out in a manner that meets ANAEROBIA's requirements using the most suitable technical, scientific, and commercial processes.

b) It will be the supplier's obligation to confirm the PURCHASE ORDER by means of its handwritten signature, in the space indicated on the document. The signature must be that of its legal representative, duly empowered attorney-in-fact, or person authorized by THE SUPPLIER for such purposes. Likewise, that document must state the supplier's confirmation that it has understood the content of this document and that it is its will to be bound by these terms for purchase orders.

3. RECEIPT OF PRODUCTS OR SERVICES

a) The receipt of both standard-line items and items manufactured according to ANAEROBIA's or third parties' engineering, as well as the provision of services, must fully correspond in quantity, weight, volume, characteristics, and technical specifications to those set out in the corresponding PURCHASE ORDER and the drawings, diagrams, etc. attached to that document, as well as the instructions regarding the location, distribution, and delivery of the products or services contained therein; these must be delivered, installed, executed, etc., as applicable, within the time period and at the place designated in the PURCHASE ORDER.

b) THE SUPPLIER must deliver the products in a manner suitable for their transport and storage so that they remain safe. In addition, each product or component, once packed and crated, must carry a label on the outside with the indications required by applicable transport regulations, as well as indications regarding any special storage conditions. These markings must include the PURCHASE ORDER number, as well as the lot or batch number, origin and destination address, quantities delivered, and/or weight. The shipment must be accompanied by a delivery note, without prices, allowing the provisions and their quantitative control to be identified; if necessary, two printed assembly and general drawings must also be attached to correctly identify subcomponents and field assembly.

c) When the purchased materials, during their use, handling, transport, or storage, could pose a hazard (for example, fire, explosion, crushing, impact, etc. to the persons handling them), the supplier must clearly and visibly indicate, on a label on the packages or wrappings of the products, phrases such as "caution," "danger," "toxic," "fragile," or another equivalent; it is also obligated to deliver to ANAEROBIA all specifications, manuals, or instructions it may have, with the steps for proper use, handling, transport, and storage. Likewise, if THE SUPPLIER was authorized to subcontract, it must require its suppliers or subcontractors to take the same measures and will be liable for any omission or lack of diligence in such obligations.

d) The dates on which the items or services must be provided to ANAEROBIA will be indicated in the observations of the PURCHASE ORDER, which, in most cases, will have been agreed in the Negotiation Protocol.

e) Should the agreed delivery deadlines not be met, or should THE SUPPLIER fail in any way to comply with the quantity, technical specifications, dimensions, weight, or quality of the items or services provided under this PURCHASE ORDER, ANAEROBIA will have the right to:

i. Rescind the PURCHASE ORDER.

ii. Return the products and/or reject the services.

iii. Receive the items and accept the services, provided that the corresponding corrections and adjustments are made in order to deliver the items and services in question according to the specifications agreed in the PURCHASE ORDER as to quantity, technical specifications, dimensions, weight, and quality of said products or services.

iv. Apply a conventional penalty for delay in accordance with the agreed commercial terms.

f) Should ANAEROBIA decide to receive the items or services under item (iii) of subsection (e) of this provision, THE SUPPLIER agrees to pay a conventional penalty, based on the PURCHASE ORDER amount, according to the following scale: for each day of delay from the original delivery date agreed in the PURCHASE ORDER, up to a maximum of 5% and/or as otherwise agreed, until the date on which the supplier delivers the products or provides the services under the specifications agreed in the PURCHASE ORDER as to quantity, measurement, weight, and quality of such products and/or services; payment of this conventional penalty does not mean that ANAEROBIA waives the right to claim further damages arising from such case. This provision applies unless otherwise specified in notes on the PURCHASE ORDER.

g) Should ANAEROBIA decide not to accept the delay in delivery of the products, reject the services, or rescind the PURCHASE ORDER, the supplier agrees to pay an additional conventional penalty of 15% of the total PURCHASE ORDER amount.

i) If the supplier's delay in the delivery period is caused by natural disasters, revolutionary movements, government blockades, import restrictions, transport difficulties, strikes, employer lockouts, shutdowns, and other manufacturing disruptions that may affect THE SUPPLIER or any of its branches, and in general any fortuitous event or force majeure beyond the supplier's control that could cause a suspension or limitation of its production or prevent shipment of the items requested in the PURCHASE ORDER, THE SUPPLIER agrees to inform ANAEROBIA of the situation, and ANAEROBIA may grant an extension of the delivery period or rescind the PURCHASE ORDER without liability to either party, and both parties agree to set a new delivery date and conditions.

j) Natural disasters, catastrophes, revolutionary movements, demonstrations, government blockades, import restrictions, transport difficulties, strikes, employer lockouts, shutdowns, and other manufacturing disruptions affecting ANAEROBIA or any of its branches, and in general any fortuitous event or force majeure beyond ANAEROBIA's control that could cause a suspension or limitation of its production or prevent it from collecting the requested items, will relieve ANAEROBIA of the obligation to receive these items while such circumstances prevail and to the extent their effects may extend, provided such disruptions could not have been avoided or could not reasonably have been avoided by normally required means. In such cases, THE SUPPLIER has no right to demand performance of this PURCHASE ORDER, and no indemnification or claim for damages will apply. If there is any impediment to receiving the requested items, THE SUPPLIER must provide suitable storage, at its own expense and risk, until ANAEROBIA is able to receive such items or have them collected by third parties. This point also applies to the provision of services.

k) Unless otherwise agreed between the parties, the costs of bonds, handling, transport, import, and delivery to the location designated by ANAEROBIA will be covered by THE SUPPLIER, including packing costs and other unforeseen expenses; therefore, no additional charges may be made for storage, packing, crating, customs agent fees, inspections, extra handling, or any other service or item.

l) In the case of installation, assembly, or any service provided by THE SUPPLIER, it will be solely responsible for complying with all legal provisions related to prevention, health guidelines, industrial safety, and fire protection established by the end client, as well as local, municipal, and corresponding federal authority guidelines.

m) If the services provided consist of the creation and development of software, or if the provision of a service requires the development of special software, in both cases the source code, as well as the documents related to the development and application of such software, will be the property of ANAEROBIA, and the supplier may only use such software as an example or basis for another project with ANAEROBIA's prior written authorization.

n) In the event of the supply of material for the installation or assembly of works requested from the supplier, both the unloading and transport of such material at the storage site will be at that supplier's own expense and risk. It is understood that it is THE SUPPLIER's responsibility to obtain all facility access permits, as well as to comply with all internal security requirements, rules and regulations, health, and any other municipal, state, or federal provision. THE SUPPLIER is at all times responsible for the custody of the materials until there is an official delivery, with a signed receipt from ANAEROBIA, at the installation site.

o) ANAEROBIA will assume the risk of the materials from the moment they are delivered by the supplier and received and accepted by ANAEROBIA, taking into account the following provisions related to acceptance of the conditions in which they are delivered, as well as those related to the warranty on the items.

4. QUALITY WARRANTY

a) The supplier expressly warrants that all elements, materials, and labor related to this PURCHASE ORDER correspond to the drawings, technical data, samples, quality, and other specifications provided by ANAEROBIA, as well as the attributes and specifications offered by the supplier. In all cases, the supplier undertakes to deliver products free of defects, made with new, first-quality materials, or, if required, with the more detailed quality specifications requested by ANAEROBIA, and with a workforce qualified to fulfill the established scope.

b) The supplier is obligated to grant ANAEROBIA the necessary authority to carry out random sampling of the materials used by the supplier, as well as the authority to carry out random sampling of the specifications of the rest in order to corroborate the quality of such items.

c) The period for claiming any correction, replacement, deficiency, or failure in the products, installations, or services provided, unless otherwise agreed in the observations of the PURCHASE ORDER, will be 24 (twenty-four) months from the date of the signed receipt or installation, as applicable. In the event of compensation, replacements, or corrections made by the supplier, the aforementioned period will begin on the date the correction, replacement, or compensation was made.

d) To guarantee the correction, replacement, or compensation of the products or services provided that may be needed, ANAEROBIA has the right to withhold 20% (twenty percent) of the total amount of the PURCHASE ORDER, to be paid to the supplier once all items or services provided have been received to ANAEROBIA's entire satisfaction in accordance with the provisions of the PURCHASE ORDER.

e) Enforcement of the above warranty does not exempt the supplier from paying the conventional penalty mentioned in item (g) of the second provision of these general purchasing conditions.

f) In cases of urgency, ANAEROBIA is authorized to correct the defects of the elements at THE SUPPLIER's expense; if this is not possible, another company may be engaged and the cost charged to the original SUPPLIER, deducting it from the final payment of the PURCHASE ORDER.

g) Products that do not conform to the specifications of the PURCHASE ORDER will be returned to THE SUPPLIER at its cost and risk. In the event of delivery of items that do not correspond to what is indicated in the PURCHASE ORDER, ANAEROBIA is authorized to rescind it without paying anything, and THE SUPPLIER agrees to reimburse the full amount of any advance payment received.

h) In the event of a dispute over the material used in the items provided, both parties agree to appoint an expert in the relevant field, in order to determine, among other things, the quality of the provisions and items, as well as the quantification of damages affecting both parties.

5. PRICES, INVOICING, AND PAYMENT TERMS

a) The agreed prices are fixed, without prejudice to the fact that they may vary during the performance of the services or supply of materials, unless by mutual agreement, due to an increase in volume requested by the end user, and this must be in writing between the parties, whether through electronic means designated by ANAEROBIA or, as applicable, in a physical document granted by them.

b) Invoices must be sent to the email address specified for that purpose. c) An invoice will not be accepted when it does not correspond to an ANAEROBIA PURCHASE ORDER, in writing and duly signed as approved for payment by ANAEROBIA's Project Manager or Operations Director.

d) Unless otherwise agreed, payment of invoices will be made 30 calendar days after receipt, delivery, and acceptance of the material and/or services, provided that the invoices and other documents necessary to make the payment are received within that period and that they contain no errors or omissions; otherwise, this will constitute justified cause to delay payment, without ANAEROBIA losing the right to receive any agreed discount as a result.

e) Delays in the delivery of invoices and other documents necessary to make a payment, errors or omissions in such documents, as well as findings of any deficiency or defect in the goods or services received, constitute justified cause to delay payment without ANAEROBIA being obligated to pay any conventional fee or accrued interest.

f) The supplier's claims against ANAEROBIA that may arise from purchase orders may not be assigned to third parties.

6. MEANS OF MANUFACTURE

a) ANAEROBIA's personnel, duly identified, have the right to visit THE SUPPLIER's workshops, plants, and facilities, with the right to inspect and test the means of manufacture, the materials used, the labor, and the elements during THE SUPPLIER's manufacturing period. Such a visit will be notified in writing three to five business days in advance, or, in urgent cases, before the inspection is carried out, indicating all areas subject to inspection. THE SUPPLIER, once duly notified, is obligated to allow free access to ANAEROBIA's representatives to its offices and facilities without limitation. For this purpose, THE SUPPLIER is obligated to make all changes and adopt any measures ANAEROBIA's personnel may request, as well as to allow any type of testing and examination carried out by such personnel.

b) THE SUPPLIER must maintain and take care of all drawings and documents provided by ANAEROBIA, as well as tools, devices, and similar items. Likewise, THE SUPPLIER must protect these materials against deterioration and loss and insure them for ANAEROBIA's benefit at its own cost. The supplier must use these drawings and/or materials only for the specific purpose indicated by ANAEROBIA.

7. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION

a) ANAEROBIA delivers, electronically or physically, to THE SUPPLIER, and THE SUPPLIER receives: schematics, drawings, technical data, "know-how," and manufacturing procedures with the character of privileged and confidential information, which will remain the property of ANAEROBIA, and THE SUPPLIER does not acquire any right to use them. Likewise, the supplier is obligated to treat ANAEROBIA's purchase orders, along with all corresponding technical and commercial details, as ANAEROBIA's trade and industrial secrets.

b) From the moment THE SUPPLIER receives information in order to quote onward, the supplier expressly undertakes to keep in absolute confidence and not disclose to third parties all information and documents received from ANAEROBIA related to this PURCHASE ORDER.

c) THE SUPPLIER is obligated to ensure that these clauses are complied with by all its employees, subcontracted personnel, and anyone it puts in contact with this information.

d) In the event of a breach of the provision mentioned in the preceding paragraph, THE SUPPLIER agrees to provide ANAEROBIA with all necessary help and cooperation to enforce the rights granted to it by applicable intellectual property legislation.

e) The supplier acknowledges and agrees that its failure to comply with the obligations under this provision will cause irreversible damages that would be difficult to calculate.

f) The parties' obligations under this provision will survive even after the cancellation, for any reason, of this PURCHASE ORDER.

g) Everything delivered under contract regarding ANAEROBIA's drawings, technical data, and manufacturing will have indefinite validity. However, the supplier may not terminate the contract until it has fulfilled any pending requests, provided ANAEROBIA insists on such compliance.

h) The supplier may only mention the business relationship it has with ANAEROBIA once ANAEROBIA has granted written permission to do so.

8. LEGALLY PROTECTED RIGHTS OF THIRD PARTIES

a) It is expressly agreed that THE SUPPLIER will use its own resources, employees, and personnel to fulfill its obligations under the PURCHASE ORDER.

b) All personnel used by THE SUPPLIER to fulfill the obligations assumed under this PURCHASE ORDER will be under the exclusive responsibility, direction, and dependency of the supplier company.

c) THE SUPPLIER is obligated to cover all benefits, rights, taxes, fees, and any other amount owed to the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS), the National Workers' Housing Fund Institute (INFONAVIT), income tax law, and any other existing or future obligation arising from its role as employer with respect to its personnel. Accordingly, THE SUPPLIER will be solely responsible for the obligations established by law as an employer with respect to the persons hired to provide the services, and hereby agrees to respond to each and every individual or collective claim that any of its employees or workers might bring against ANAEROBIA.

9. SPECIAL AGREEMENTS

a) ANAEROBIA has the right to modify, at any time, the specifications and quantities of the PURCHASE ORDER, the plans and drawings on which the PURCHASE ORDER is based, the indications regarding the means of transport and type of packaging, as well as the place of delivery indicated in the purchase orders. If such changes give rise to additional costs, these will be covered by ANAEROBIA to THE SUPPLIER after the impact has been analyzed and agreed by both parties.

b) In relation to the provisions of the preceding article, both parties will agree on a new delivery date, set taking into account the modifications ANAEROBIA requires from the supplier. The agreement establishing the new date must be a written document signed by both parties.

c) If the PURCHASE ORDER is of an international nature, both parties may determine the "INCOTERM" most convenient for their interests in that transaction. The agreement determining the applicable "INCOTERM" will supersede any provision contained herein regarding the conditions supporting such "INCOTERM." The agreement determining the "INCOTERM" must follow the procedures set out in the preceding provision and be recorded in writing in the observations of the PURCHASE ORDER.

d) For the purposes of the preceding provision, "INCOTERM" will be defined as those established by the International Chamber of Commerce in its 2010 version.

10. INDEMNIFICATION

a) From the signing of the PURCHASE ORDER, THE SUPPLIER agrees to defend, hold harmless, and, where applicable, indemnify ANAEROBIA against any action, claim, proceeding, requirement, judgment, limitation, and associated expenses and costs, including attorneys' fees, with respect to damages arising from any tax, labor, civil, criminal, administrative, or other liability of the supplier arising from acts or omissions of the supplier company or any of its officers, professionals, technicians, workers, employees, and members of its staff or subcontractors, related to this PURCHASE ORDER.

11. CANCELLATION

a) ANAEROBIA has the right to cancel this PURCHASE ORDER without any liability to THE SUPPLIER in any of the following cases:

i. When confirmation of the PURCHASE ORDER is not received within the agreed period.

ii. When the delivery date exceeds the time established in the PURCHASE ORDER and such delay prevents ANAEROBIA from fulfilling its obligations to third parties.

iii. When the supplier does not have a current civil liability insurance policy covering third-party liability, where this has been specified in the Negotiation Protocol.

iv. When the supplier does not honor the price negotiated after the PURCHASE ORDER has been issued.

v. If, based on inspection visits carried out by ANAEROBIA, it is evident that THE SUPPLIER will not be able to meet the schedule established in the PURCHASE ORDER. Likewise, ANAEROBIA may cancel the PURCHASE ORDER at any time, upon prior written notice to the supplier of such situation. In cases where ANAEROBIA must pay compensation equivalent to the costs incurred by the supplier for work carried out in connection with the PURCHASE ORDER, ANAEROBIA will only pay for processed products and not for raw materials.

12. TERMINATION OF THE PURCHASE ORDER

a) ANAEROBIA's relationship with the supplier, created by the PURCHASE ORDER, will be deemed terminated when:

i. The items or services have been fully delivered and accepted by ANAEROBIA and payment in full has been made.

ii. Its purpose becomes impossible.

iii. Both parties mutually agree to terminate it.

13. RESCISSION

a) ANAEROBIA may rescind this PURCHASE ORDER without need for judicial intervention and without liability, by means of a written, extrajudicial notice sent to the company's address stating the grounds for rescission, in the following cases, which are illustrative and not limiting:

i. Where the agreed delivery conditions are not met, or there is any other failure by the supplier with respect to the quantity, measurement, weight, or quality of the items or services ordered, and ANAEROBIA decides to rescind this PURCHASE ORDER.

ii. When, in ANAEROBIA's judgment, the material used in the items does not meet the specifications in the PURCHASE ORDER.

iii. In the event that delivery of the goods or services by the supplier repeatedly fails to conform to the PURCHASE ORDER.

iv. If the supplier refuses to show ANAEROBIA its civil liability insurance policy when requested.

v. If dissolution and/or liquidation proceedings have begun for the partners forming part of the supplier company.

vi. If a strike notice or any other work stoppage has been filed against the supplier, for as long as the situation is not resolved within fifteen days from the date the event occurs.

vii. Because it is impossible to achieve the purpose of this PURCHASE ORDER due to force majeure.

viii. In all cases provided for by law.

ix. If the end client orders the removal of subcontracted personnel for misconduct, theft of property, being under the influence of toxic substances, physical or verbal violence, and/or aggression against personnel or property, or any other issue that makes it impossible to continue the work in accordance with the general schedule agreed in the purchase order.

b) The supplier may rescind this PURCHASE ORDER in the following cases:

i. Nonpayment of one or more invoices by ANAEROBIA without prior justification, by mutual agreement and notice.

ii. If dissolution and liquidation proceedings have begun for the partners forming part of the supplier company.

iii. If a strike notice or any other work stoppage has been filed against the supplier, provided this situation is not resolved within fifteen days from the date the event occurs.

14. VALIDITY IN CASE OF PARTIAL NULLITY

a) If any provision of these purchasing conditions is voided for any reason agreed between the parties, the validity of the remaining conditions and provisions will not be affected, unless rescission occurs due to breach.

15. INTERPRETATION

a) In the event the supplier is foreign and requires a copy of this document, it will be prepared in English.

b) In the event of any doubt regarding the interpretation of the provisions due to language, such interpretation will be valid only in the Spanish language.

16. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

a) If the supplier is not Mexican, in the event of any dispute arising from the interpretation or execution of the PURCHASE ORDER or amendments thereto, both parties expressly agree to finally resolve all disputes through arbitration in accordance with the rules and procedures of the International Chamber of Commerce ("ICC") Rules of Arbitration.

b) The arbitration referred to in the preceding paragraph will be subject to the following conditions:

i. Either THE SUPPLIER or ANAEROBIA may initiate the arbitration proceeding.

ii. The place of arbitration will be Mexico City, United Mexican States; therefore, for all purposes of the arbitration and legal jurisdiction, as applicable, the parties expressly waive any jurisdiction that might correspond to them by reason of their present or future domiciles.

iii. The parties will decide in each case whether the arbitral decision will be at law or in amiable composition. Unless the law provides otherwise, or in the absence of agreement between the parties, the decision will be rendered in amiable composition. In all decisions at law, the decision will be based on the legislation of the United Mexican States.

iv. The language of the arbitration will be Spanish. v. The arbitral award will be final and binding on both parties; accordingly, they waive any right of appeal.

c) When the supplier is Mexican, both parties agree to submit to the jurisdiction and competence of the courts of the city of Puebla, Puebla, waiving any other jurisdiction that might correspond to them by reason of their present or future location.

17. INSURANCE

a) THE SUPPLIER states that it holds a comprehensive civil liability insurance policy, valid during the performance of the works or services, which covers civil liability to third parties, and undertakes to show it to ANAEROBIA at the time this PURCHASE ORDER is issued.

b) If the supplier does not have an insurance policy, and the works and/or services to be performed under the PURCHASE ORDER require one, it hereby agrees to obtain Civil Liability Insurance covering third parties and must show such policy to ANAEROBIA within a period of 10 business days from the date this PURCHASE ORDER is issued.

c) Should the supplier fail to comply with the requirements set forth in this provision, ANAEROBIA may, at its option, cancel or, as applicable, request the rescission of this PURCHASE ORDER.

18. APPLICABLE LAW

Unless otherwise agreed, both parties agree that for any dispute or litigation arising from the PURCHASE ORDER, the competent courts of Puebla, Puebla, or of Mexico City, Federal District, will have jurisdiction, at ANAEROBIA's election.
